_about: The free-placed level objects, shared by the game (level_data.gd, level_geometry.gd, grid_nav.gd) and the level editor. Sizes are metres. on_cell: what an object sitting square on a cell does to it ('wall' = counts as a wall for nav / lighting but no solid block is built; 'open' = punches a walkable opening through a wall). blocks_nav: when placed off-centre, the monster can't path across its span. A new structural type needs a builder in level_geometry.gd _build_objects(); the editor draws unknown types as a plain slab. A type with a 'model' key is instead a decorative clutter prop: level_geometry.gd's generic _build_props() instances that FBX/GLB and builds a PBR material from 'textures' (albedo/normal/roughness/metallic/emissive), no per-type builder needed. 'scatter': true marks it eligible for the level editor's random SCATTER PROPS tool. 'scale' on these objects (0.5-4.0, same field as thin_wall/arch width) is reused as a uniform size multiplier. Walls come in plan shapes ('shape': 'slab' straight, 'corner' an L, 'arc' a curve round the object's origin, 'pillar' / 'column' free-standing), built by level_geometry.gd _build_shaped_walls() / _build_column() from the same centre line level_data.gd shape_path() gives the nav. 'params' lists the per-object fields a type has beyond position / rotation / scale, with their defaults; the level editor's inspector shows exactly those (thick: metres, height: metres with 0 = up to the ceiling and anything under 1.8 m seen over, arc: degrees, depth: cells, event / text / once / delay / duration: a trigger's). 'max_scale' raises the 4-cell cap on scale, 'align': false stops the editor turning a piece to fit the wall it lands on. A 'zone' shape is an event trigger (props/event_trigger.gd), its 'events' the choices of what it runs.

thin_wall.label: Thin wall
thin_wall.help: A slim partition. Thickness and Height in the inspector (Height 0 = up to the ceiling)

arch.label: Arch
arch.help: A round-topped opening through a full wall. Put it square on a wall cell to punch through it

door.label: Door
door.help: A framed wood door set in its own thin wall; opens as you approach

stairs_up.label: Stairs up
stairs_up.help: A flight of steps up to the floor above. Walk up it (towards the arrow) to go there; you arrive beside that floor's Stairs down nearest this spot. Put it square on a floor cell

stairs_down.label: Stairs down
stairs_down.help: A flight of steps down to the floor below, sunk into its cell (the editor makes the cell a pit). Walk down it (towards the arrow) to go there; you arrive beside that floor's Stairs up nearest this spot

half_wall.label: Half wall
half_wall.help: A waist-high partition: office cubicles, a counter, a railing along a drop. You see over it, you can't walk through it

wall_corner.label: Corner wall
wall_corner.help: An L of two walls meeting at the origin, each leg Width cells long: one along the facing arrow, one to its right. Put the origin on a cell corner to run the legs along cell edges

wall_curve.label: Curved wall
wall_curve.help: A wall bent round a circle centred on the origin: Width is the circle's diameter in cells, Arc how much of it is built, centred on the facing arrow. 90 rounds off a corner; 300-360 makes a round room (leave a gap to get in)

pillar.label: Square pillar
pillar.help: A free-standing wallpapered pillar, Thickness metres on a side. Rows of them make a pillar hall; square on a cell, that cell's tube light moves off it

column.label: Round column
column.help: A plastered round column, Thickness metres across

trigger.label: Event trigger
trigger.help: An invisible box that runs an event when the player walks into it: Width across the arrow, Depth along it (cells). Pick the Event, an optional Text caption, a Delay, and whether it only ever fires Once

events.message: Show the Text as a caption
events.lights_out: The tubes over the box die for Duration seconds, then re-strike
events.flicker: The tubes over the box stutter
events.silence: The ambience drains away for Duration seconds; only the hum is left
events.drone: A low drone swells for Duration seconds
events.wallKnock: Director event: knocking inside a wall behind you
events.breathBehind: Director event: something breathing on your neck
events.preacherWhisper: Director event: a preacher's voice down a corridor
events.tiltDrift: Director event: the world slowly tilts
events.powerCut: Director event: the whole floor's power fails for a minute

prop_explosive_barrel.help: A rusty red hazard drum. Purely decorative clutter
